title: Schema evolution without compatibility mode — breaking change deployed
expected_feedback: Standard: a field (currency) was removed from the event schema with no compatibility gate. Whether this is safe depends on the mode and on whether the field carried a default — BACKWARD does permit deleting an optional/defaulted field, so 'never delete anything' is the wrong rule. Here currency is required with no default, which is incompatible under every mode. Fix: (1) register the subject in Schema Registry with a deliberate compatibility mode and verify candidates against the registry's /compatibility endpoint before deploy; (2) remember the deployment order the mode implies — BACKWARD means a NEW reader reads OLD data, so consumers upgrade first; (3) for a genuinely breaking change, dual-publish to a new topic (order.events.v2) and migrate consumers.
checklist_anchor: Schema compatibility mode chosen deliberately, and stated in the right direction
